entities.name: Muchtar Pakpahan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muchtar Pakpahan was an Indonesian labor leader who founded the first independent trade union in Indonesia. Pakpahan was active as a lawyer at Muchtar Pakpahan & Associates Law Firm and taught at the law faculty of the Indonesian Christian University (UKI).
